Mod.name: The Witch's Sealbook
Mod.description:
[h1]The Witch's Sealbook[/h1] Draw magic seals by hand and cast them, as in [i]Witch Hat Atelier[/i].
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Andrinha/witch-sealbook/main/docs/spellbook.gif[/img]
[h2]How it works[/h2] Open the spellbook and draw a seal: a [b]ring[/b], an [b]element sigil[/b] in the middle and [b]signs[/b] around it. Signs decide what the magic becomes: a shot, a wave, an orb, rain, a field. Together they make [b]over 5,000 seals[/b]. Hold the book and click to cast.
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Andrinha/witch-sealbook/main/docs/flame_shot.gif[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]127 seals[/b] from the manga, learned from sheets found in the world [*][b]Seven inks[/b] that change how a seal behaves [*][b]Three books[/b], from a small Palm Quire to the Great Tome [/list]
[h2]Notes[/h2] The code was written with the help of AI; design and testing are mine. Unofficial fan mod. Bug reports are welcome. [url=https://github.com/Andrinha/witch-sealbook]Source code[/url]
